landing.headline: Your AI drafts the offer. You decide.
landing.subhead: When your shop is quiet or stock is about to expire, ShopNod suggests a discount inside the limits you set. Nothing goes live until you approve it.
landing.processHeadline: Your shop sets the rules. ShopNod handles the busywork.
landing.ctaBody: Start a demo shop and see the complete approval flow.
landing.trustPill: Human in the loop, every time
landing.trustCardBody: Every draft is checked against price, discount, stock and budget limits before you ever see it.
landing.judgeNote: No password, no card. Set up a demo shop in about 90 seconds.
landing.exampleTitle: What you will see in your inbox
landing.exampleReason: Quiet for 40 minutes, 38% below a normal Tuesday. 12 croissants expire tonight.
landing.step1Body: Press I'm quiet, or let ShopNod notice a slow hour or stock that is about to expire.
landing.step2Body: The AI can never go above your maximum discount, below your minimum price, or on items you protect.
landing.step3Body: Approve, edit or reject. Nothing is published without you. Every decision teaches the next draft.
landing.step4Body: Nearby shoppers get the offer. They show a QR code, you scan it, and you pay only per redemption.
landing.footer: ShopNod. Same price for everyone, honest discounts, and a human always in charge.
landing.watchStoryNote: Both sides, live, in one minute

intro.title: Tuesday, 4 pm. Ali's Bakery is quiet.
intro.body: Two customers in the last hour, when there are usually nine. Twelve croissants expire tonight. Ali is busy baking, not watching numbers.

quiet.title: ShopNod notices before Ali does.
quiet.body: It compares this hour with the same hour on past Tuesdays. 78% quieter than usual, with stock about to go to waste: worth an offer.

ai.title: The AI drafts an offer, inside Ali's limits.
ai.body: The Shop Agent reads opening hours, stock and expiry, what Ali approved before, and his limits, through tools. Then it writes the offer and explains why, in plain words.

guardrails.title: Every draft is checked against hard limits.
guardrails.body: Minimum price, maximum discount, budget, number of customers, items never to discount. The AI can read these limits but never change them, and it has no way to publish anything.

approve.title: Nothing goes live until Ali taps Approve.
approve.body: One tap, or edit or reject. It is his money, so it is his decision, and every decision is logged.

match.title: Only the neighbours it suits are told.
match.body: ShopNod predicts who would want this right now: the rainy evening, a shopping list with croissants on it, what they liked before. Out of everyone nearby, only those people get a notification. No names or locations leave the server.

offer.title: A shopper sees why, and gets a QR code.
offer.body: Every offer says why it is shown, and that everyone sees the same price. One tap gives a signed, one-time QR code (and a short code if the camera fails).

scan.title: Ali scans it at the counter.
scan.body: The code is checked, locked and redeemed exactly once. A second scan, a code for another shop or an expired code is refused, in plain words.

redeemed.title: Redeemed. The shopper saved money.
redeemed.body: The phone updates by itself the moment Ali scans. Croissants that would have been thrown away are eaten instead.

impact.title: A quiet hour turned into customers, and it learns.
impact.body: More neighbours redeem on their own. Ali pays only per customer ShopNod actually brings. Next time, ShopNod remembers what Ali approved and when, and drafts even better offers.
